items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: And then Benny Carter was in the band, and he was just getting started -- him and Benny Waters. He had a great band.

ctx.x: Rehearsal. We had rehearsal once a week -- twice a week. One week was a -- Tuesday night -- was the Tuesday afternoon was the day that we let the song pluggers come out. The other rehearsals, Thursday, was strictly for Ella and the band. Nobody was allowed there. We would rehearse that day, too, when the song pluggers come out. But then we had a private rehearsal if you wanted to hear your song. You wouldn't hear it in no rehearsal. You'd have to come out and listen to it there. (inaudible) "We're going to put…
You had copies or were they just lead sheets that were passed around?
